## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Outer Chapters of the Master Embracing the Unhewn*

by [葛洪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%91%9B%E6%B4%AA) (Gě Hóng, 283–343)

The ***Outer Chapters*** of the *Bào pǔ zǐ* — Gě Hóng's **socio-political-philosophical** companion to the *Inner Chapters* [KR5f0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5f/KR5f0019), in 50 *juàn*. Where the *Inner Chapters* argue for immortality practices, the *Outer Chapters* engage with Confucian social-moral discourse: ruler-subject relations, scholarship, literature, honesty, friendship. Preserved as **DZ 1187** / CT 1187 (Tài qīng bù 太清部).

**Dating.** *c.* 317–330. Dynasty: 東晉.
